docs.title: KEEPR: Press Release
docs.text:
Press Release entitled "Keepers net income jumped by 17.6% to PHP 811 million in 1Q 2026"

Manila, Philippines – Lucio Co-led The Keepers Holdings Inc. (Keepers), the largest imported liquor distribution in the Philippines, grew first quarter 2026 net income to Php 811 million growing 17.6% versus Php 690 million the previous year driven by the strong sales volume performance from the imported brandy segment. Keepers recorded consolidated revenue for the first quarter of 2026 amounting to Php 4.3 billion, a 6.1% growth versus the previous year on the back of an 4% growth in volume of cases sold for the period. This was driven principally by Alfonso, the leading imported brandy in the market, which has already surpassed its pre-pandemic levels, a premiumizing market and on-premise channel rebound. The Keepers Holdings Group has brought and served Filipino consumers the leading international brands of spirits, wines and specialty beverages into the Philippines. These iconic global brands include Johnnie Walker, Chivas Regal, Glenfiddich, Suntory, Jinro, Jose Cuervo, Jim Beam, Penfolds, Red Bull and many others.
